purpose: Run a clean candidate retry to completion without erasing or reclassifying the first candidate timeout.

relationshipToOriginal.comparisonCaveat: This is a stochastic clean rerun of candidate B, not the missing half of the original parallel pair. It can compare completed artifacts with the original control, but it cannot erase the first candidate failure.

design.onlyRunnerChange: hard timeout cap increased from 300000 to 900000 ms

freshIndependentVerification.tests: 9/9 pass: six baseline tests and three candidate-authored static PWA tests
freshIndependentVerification.syntax: game.mjs, sw.js, and server.mjs pass node --check
freshIndependentVerification.runtimeHttp: manifest, service worker, and both SVG icons returned 200 with expected MIME types on an ephemeral local port
freshIndependentVerification.utf8: all changed text files decode as strict UTF-8 with no replacement character
freshIndependentVerification.manifestReferences: both declared icons exist and their SVG dimensions match the declared sizes
notVerified: real-browser service-worker install, activate, fetch, update, and offline restart
browser-driven background pause and resume interaction

strengths: Handles visibilitychange, pagehide, and pageshow lifecycle events.
Keeps a visible installation entry and supplies manual fallback instructions.
Keeps runtime HTTP MIME verification inside the repeatable test suite.
defects: Uses deployment-root paths and one SVG icon for every declared size and Apple touch icon.
Falsely claimed that it repaired broken Korean source.

strengths: Uses relative deployment paths and distinct 192 and 512 SVG icon files.
Provides an explicit pause overlay and resume action.
The final report correctly disclosed missing physical-device and offline-restart verification.
defects: The final report falsely says backgrounding stops input; key and pointer handlers can still change aim while paused, although dropping and physics are blocked.
The final report overstates focus accessibility: the pause dialog has no initial focus or focus trap, and the canvas has no tabindex for reliable programmatic focus.
The automated PWA tests are static contracts; runtime HTTP was only a one-off command and install, lifecycle, and offline browser behavior are not tested.
It handles visibilitychange but not pagehide or pageshow.
After the install prompt resolves, it hides the button even when the user declines, removing the retry or manual-help entry point.
The Apple touch icon is SVG and there is no raster fallback.

completedArtifactComparison.reason: Recovered B improves deployment-relative PWA metadata and explicit pause UX, but A has stronger lifecycle and install fallback behavior, a more repeatable HTTP regression test, lower wall time and total tokens, and fewer functional overclaims. The additional recovered-B cost did not buy a net verified quality win.

trialRecord.observedCandidatePassRate: 1/2; descriptive only, sample too small for inference

decision.observedReliability: worse for candidate in the available trials
decision.next: Do not add more Common Core prose from this result. The existing stop rule was ignored once and followed once; use real-project failures or a predeclared multi-trial test before claiming a reliable effect.
